scope: 12张截图，36个去重条目：34篇论文、1软件项目、1汇总主题；汇总主题另补11篇代表论文

papers.title: Neural Dynamics Self-Attention for Spiking Transformers

papers.notes: Do not confuse forwarded article date with publication year.
